title: Patient-Reported Outcome Measures (PROMs) on the Stroke Unit at the UKSH: An explorative mixed-method design of an implementation scientific pilot study (PROMImpact)
summary: Mixed-methods study to evaluate an implementation science pilot study on the stroke unit of the UKSH, Lübeck campus. To this end, the integration, feasibility and practicability of PROMs in everyday care will be examined in a process evaluation. The research project is a part of a Master's thesis in the Master's program in Health and Health Care Sciences at the University of Lübeck.
conditions: Stroke, not specified as haemorrhage or infarction

interventions.name: With the help of the PROM measurement instruments PROMIS®-29 Profile v2.1 (PROMIS-29) and the short form 4a - Cognitive Functions (4-item short version on cognitive functions), medical and nursing staff should obtain information on the patient-reported quality of life and assessment of the patient's

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
ischemic or hemorrhagic stroke event, treated in the Stroke Unit at the Lübeck Campus, UKSH.
Exclusion criteria:
Severe aphasia, insufficient cognitive ability to complete the questionnaire, lack of German language skills
